svg.title: Wall
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after Wall. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colours. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/wall/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
